choices.why: This pale birch table seats four, has simple Nordic lines, and its 125 cm length fits the free floor beside the kitchenette without crowding the walkway.
This black chair has the same sturdy Nordic frame as the table, giving a clean contrast of black against light wood that the user asked for.
This simple white bell pendant blends into the white walls and ceiling and lights the center of the table without visual clutter.
This low white sideboard with light wood fronts nearly disappears against the white wall and matches the white and light wood finishes of the kitchenette.

answer.why: The light birch, white, and black palette picks up the white and light wood of the kitchenette and the gray floor, creating a simple, bright Nordic dining area. Repeating the same table and chair line keeps the look cohesive.
